Unplaced on all three point-to-point runs, the Eric McNamara-trained filly took a significant step forward when reaching the frame at the first time of asking over flights. Travelling into the race easily, the daughter of Walk In The Park wandered around approaching two out, before staying on late. With the benefit of that experience, she can score here. Dual bumper winner Dunkerque has yet to replicate that form over hurdles but has time on his side. Newcomer The Grey Poet is worth a second look in the market.

RAVENSCRAIG CASTLE is the pick though, another last time out winner in good style last time, that was after a long losing run and well treated on old flat form looks to be in with a big chance.
